slug: 2026-05-07 What will determine the success of Rwanda’s data governance push

facts.fact: Cenfri, interviewing NISR's Data Governance Project Lead, lists building the data sharing platform itself among the Data Governance Unit's current foundation work, and says institutions should publish quality-assured datasets through it over the next three to five years.

systems.owner: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (Data Governance Unit)
